### God Removes and Sets Up Leaders (A Study of Daniel 2:21)
Author: Emma Danzey
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/the-god-over-rulers-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Daniel 2:21
Points:
- In times of political tension and societal change, believers can rest in God's supreme authority.
- God directs the shifting seasons of history and works all circumstances toward His ultimate purposes.
- No leader rises or falls outside of God's sovereign allowance and control.
- Political anxieties should not distract Christians from their primary calling to make disciples.
- Believers must rely on God's Word and the Holy Spirit for discernment when navigating difficult decisions.

### Make the Right Decision, Not Just a Fast One
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-october-19-2024.html
Passage: Daniel 2:16
Points:
- High-pressure situations tempt people to make impulsive, emotionally driven choices.
- Daniel provided a model of wisdom under pressure by requesting more time rather than reacting in haste.
- Arriving at the correct decision is far more important than arriving at a quick one.
- Stepping back and pausing creates the necessary room to calm down and talk to God.
- Sound choices come from seeking divine perspective through Scripture and prayer instead of worldly urgency.
